definitions.gloss: to return; to give back; to hand back
definitions.explanation: To return something that was borrowed, rented, or temporarily in one's possession. More formal than {返|かえ}す.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返却|へんきゃく}する。
⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧して⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please return the book to the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦レンタカー→レンタカー：23193_rentakaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}→営業所：23605_eigyousho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: The rental car must be returned to the office.

notes:
Compound of {返|へん} (return) + {却|きゃく} (reject, dismiss). More formal than ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧. Commonly used in institutional contexts — libraries, rental services, and official procedures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{返却|へんきゃく}{期限|きげん}→返却期限：25290_henkyakukigen⟧: return deadline
- ⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧{日|び}: return date
- ⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧: book return drop box
- ⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: return procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧: to return (everyday, casual)
- ⟦{返品|へんぴん}→返品：05465_henpin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to return merchandise (specifically goods to a store)
- {返納|へんのう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to return to the authorities (licenses, official items — very formal)
